items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 19:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the building of the Nukva in the palace of Aba and Ima? The matter of the building of the Nukva was explained above in Answer 18, that it is the completion of her NHY of vessels, where is the principal discernment of her femininity. See there. And this is done by the Mochin of the GAR of Ima of the AB of the Mazal, when ZON both ascend together to Aba and Ima, by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in its Netzach, as above in Answer 6. And then she can receive directly from Aba and Ima, like ZA, and is found to be built in the palace of Aba and Ima, meaning above her degree, for Aba and Ima are the aspect of the upper of the upper of her, since her upper is ZA, her husband; and the aspect of Aba and Ima is called, for this reason, the authority of the groom, as above in Answer 12. See there. However, were it not for this, she would not be able to raise her AHP and be built with NHY of vessels, for there is no raising of the AHP except by the AB of the Mazalot, which lowers the lower Hey from the eyes to the mouth. As is known. And therefore the Nukva is compelled to be built only in the palace of Aba and Ima. (Item 136).
